context: A teacher walks a uni student through a sociology paper
purpose: Teach: アイデンティティ/苦悩/根源/嫌悪/落語/教団/風俗/戦車

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レポート読んだよ。テーマは『現代人のアイデンティティの危機』だったよね。
lines.en: I read your paper. The theme was 'the identity crisis of modern people,' right?
lines.style: Warm professorial tone, opens with gentle acknowledgment before critique.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。書いてる途中、自分でも何が言いたいのか分からなくなって、苦悩しました。
lines.en: Yes. Halfway through writing, I lost track of what I wanted to say, and I really struggled.
lines.style: Honest student voice, slightly deflated, admits to genuine difficulty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 問題の根源はね、対象が広すぎることなの。たとえば落語の世界と新興教団を同じ章で論じてるでしょ。
lines.en: The root of the problem is that your scope is too broad. For example, you discuss rakugo and new religious groups in the same chapter.
lines.style: Diagnostic and direct, points to a concrete structural flaw.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦後の風俗を横断的に見たかったんです。戦車が街を走った時代の空気まで含めて。
lines.en: I wanted to look across postwar customs, including the atmosphere of the era when tanks rolled through the streets.
lines.style: Eager but unfocused, reveals research ambition spilling beyond manageable scope.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意欲は買うけど、嫌悪されるような散漫な論文になっちゃうよ。端的に言うと、一つの事例を深く掘る方が学術的に値するの。
lines.en: I appreciate the drive, but it'll become the kind of scattered paper readers dislike. Bluntly put, drilling deep into one case has more academic merit.
lines.style: Encouraging yet firm, mixes empathy with clear academic standards.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ落語家のコミュニティに絞って、師弟関係から見える自己像を探索する方向で。
lines.en: Then I'll narrow it to the rakugo performers' community and explore self-image through master-apprentice relationships.
lines.style: Quick recovery, shows the student can pivot once given direction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それいいね。来週までに章立てを直して持っておいで。活力ある議論にしよう。
lines.en: That sounds great. Bring me the revised chapter outline by next week. Let's make this a lively discussion.
lines.style: Closes warmly with concrete deadline and motivating final push.
